delta_review: Only selector/diagnostics, failed-attempt status bookkeeping, six new source/synthetic tests, and README differ. Actual settings/restart assertions, unmodified production Kotlin path, Swift observation schema/probe, P2p/privacy/session controls, copied shell phase, simulator/process/FIFO cleanup and frozen dirty source are unchanged.

Exact new Settings selector is derived from actual bottom tab and exact CMP1.10.3 node traversal. Fake-content-description, hint-vs-label, merged-vs-unmerged tree and language option sibling paths independently examined. Separate research ledger records exact files/ranges.

Diagnostics issue exact equality queries for only twelve fixed public EN/AR labels. count capped32, element inspection prefix4, encoded output limit8192bytes. No arbitrary labels/values/debugDescription/tree export and no fallback tap. Swift conditional array has known XCUIElement array context; JSON dictionary values are representable fixed strings/ints/arrays. Compilation/runtime still must execute.

RUNNING persisted immediately before xcode command; protected verifier failures turn attempted state into FAIL while preflight retains NOT_RUN. Final root status still requires successful runtime, cleanup, source and controls. RUNNING means Xcode verification attempt, not proof any XCTest executed; raw test reports are still authoritative.

AST-handler tests select unique real receipt error handler, replay actual statements with synthetic failed strict verifier, and inspect actual guarded Xcode/start/save ordering. Current live CFG was independently read; line-number test alone is not general CFG proof and none of these mocks claim an actual XCTest.

Selector contracts read actual EN/AR XML values and compare exact fixture literals/diagnostic allowlist; discovery remains standard unittest test_* with all36 entries executed in root raw log. No assertions relaxed to pass.

limitations: Source approval never establishes successful runtime. Raw XCTest/probe results require a separate independent review.

Not active-game/session retention proof, direct Compose LayoutDirection measurement, actual OS Settings app execution, physical-device/LAN proof, app-switcher/gesture/VoiceOver proof, power-loss durability, Store signing, or release readiness.
Unmarked old AppleLanguages provenance remains an unresolved product/migration policy. No deletion of legitimate unowned OS preferences authorized.
Selector runtime failure must be classified from actual evidence; no production defect or successful repair inferred from a fixture failure.
SIGKILL/host death cannot execute finalizers; durable receipt is required for precise owned-path recovery.
